title: h5writeatt
summary: Write an HDF5 attribute on a file, group, or dataset.

gpu_support.notes: Attribute writes are host file I/O and are not acceleration operations.

description: `h5writeatt(filename, location, attribute, data)` creates or replaces an attribute at the file root, a group, or a dataset.
behaviors: Numeric, logical, string, and char attributes are supported.
Unsupported MATLAB value classes raise deterministic unsupported-type errors.
